v.rationale: Both behave identically: all suites pass, and probes (multibyte length, whitespace trimmed to null, integer rejected, real Sanctum token response shape, PUT returns 405) passed for both. Neither has a bug. impl-1 ranks first because it uses a JsonResource to shape the response (the standard Laravel API convention) and its Pest tests are tidier, using named datasets. impl-2 is slightly simpler and has marginally broader assertions, but its $user->only() helper is a hand-rolled resource. The gap is small; impl-1's naming mismatch and prefix ceremony keep it close.
